doc.title: Mike Longo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2019

title: Opening and the organized big band book
summary: Monk Rowe opens in Longo's home; Longo explains how the bass player organizes the band's arrangements.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to be in the home of Mike Longo. I’m going to list a few things and you can edit. I’m looking at your collection of arrangements over here.

Yeah we just arranged it that way man, so it’s much easier. My book got so big, the books were like this thick man, and carrying all that stuff man, and the guys would drop them on the floor. So the bass player did all that. He put each arrangement, everything you see sticking out is what we’re playing Monday night.
